annotations.title: Add a book to my library

description: Put a book on one of the signed-in reader's shelves, move it to a different shelf, rate it, or record how far through it they are. The workId is one returned by search_books, get_book or recommend_from_titles. "Finished it, four stars" is one call with readingStatus FINISHED and rating 4. Each field given replaces what the reader had there before, so send a rating or a note only when they asked for that one to change. Omitting readingStatus leaves the book on the shelf it is already on.

notes.description: The reader's own note on the book, private to them

readingStatus.description: The shelf to put the book on. Omit to leave it where it is, or NOT_STARTED for a book the reader has not opened yet.
